camera.reason: 48MP sensor-shift OIS main with a 12MP ultrawide and Dolby Vision 4K60 video, but no telephoto.

performance.reason: Apple A18 on 3nm runs every current game at high settings with room to spare.

battery.reason: 4,674mAh in an efficient phone easily lasts a full day plus, though charging tops out around 20W wired.

display.reason: Large 6.7 inch OLED reaching 2,000 nits outdoors, held back by a 60Hz refresh rate.

build.reason: Aluminium frame with Ceramic Shield glass front and back and IP68 at 6 metres.

software.reason: Apple commits to at least 5 years of security updates (UK PSTI statement) and has historically shipped about 6 major iOS upgrades.

value.reason: The 362,000 official PTA price is within reach of iPhone 17, which adds 120Hz, a 48MP ultrawide and 256GB.

availability.reason: No PTA approved unit was in stock on 2026-10-11; only Mega.pk's non-PTA stock was buyable.

notes: PTA prices are WhatMobile official prices (361,999 and 401,999); Shophive's PTA 128GB listing is out of stock and PriceOye does not list the 16 Plus. The only in-stock unit found was Mega.pk's non-PTA 128GB at 241,999 (shop warranty). Apple still sells the 16 Plus in other markets. osUpdates is an assumption: Apple publishes no iOS upgrade count. RAM (8GB) is from GSMArena.
